title: Reverse the Words
story: Reverse the order of the words, not the letters.
goal: Write reverse_words(s): return the words of s in reverse order, joined by single spaces. Extra spaces are dropped.
hints: split() with no argument splits on any run of spaces.
socratic: What does split() do with extra spaces?
How do you reverse a list?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Reverse the Words”?
